title: Optimal Transport and the ABP Method in Higher Codimension
summary: We prove an inverse optimal-transport principle for the ABP contact set of animmersed submanifold. A fixed function on the submanifold determines, for every probability density on a bounded convex target, a source measure and an optimal plan. For a uniform ellipsoidal target, disintegration over the submanifold gives conditional measures whose fiberwise $L^\infty$-norms satisfy a sharp weighted average estimate with constant $ω_n/ω_{n+m}$ in codimensions $1\leq m\leq4$.
